metadata.title: Write a Report File
metadata.description: Overwrite a report file with a two-line summary using write mode.

instructions.main: Write `report.txt` containing exactly two lines: `Items processed: 5` then `Average: 2.5`. If an old `report.txt` exists, replace its contents.
steps: Open the file for writing: `with open("report.txt", "w") as f:`.
Mode `"w"` overwrites the file from scratch — mode `"a"` would keep the old content.

hints.message: Open `report.txt` with `with open("report.txt", "w") as f:` and `f.write(...)` both summary lines.
Printing sends the summary to the console, not to the file — write it into `report.txt` with `f.write(...)`.
`report.txt` must contain only the new summary — open it in write mode (`open("report.txt", "w")`), not read mode, and don't carry the old content forward.

evaluation.feedback_on_all_pass: report.txt contains exactly the two-line summary.

test_cases.feedback_on_pass: The report contains exactly the two summary lines.
test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Write `report.txt` so it contains exactly `Items processed: 5` and `Average: 2.5` — replacing any old content, not adding to it.

test_cases.feedback_on_pass: You opened the file in write mode.
test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Open the file for writing with `open("report.txt", "w")` — the `"w"` mode truncates the old content.
